sources.note: Nothing. The paper (a 1916 lecture) is ethnohistorical reminiscence: naming of the Bay and islands, the Amity Point 'Noon-nuckles' and the Moreton Island 'Nooghies', corroborees, individual people, then pp. 113-114 a list of place names 'according to the native pronunciation' (Tangalooma = Doongalooma, Cowan-Cowan = Gowan-Gowan 'blood blood', Gheebellum, Buingumba, etc.) and pp. 127-129 a c. 120-item English-native wordlist plus five short sentences, explicitly 'in the Noon-nuckle (or Stradbroke Island native) dialect'. No remark anywhere on accent, stress, emphasis, syllables, vowel length o…
